{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:OrnFreeTaaHS-SWE.png]] |name=Orn Free Taa |homeworld=[[Ryloth]]{{Databank|orn-free-taa|Orn Free Taa}} |birth= |death= |species=[[Twi'lek]] {{C|[[Rutian]]}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height=1.84 [[meter]]s {{C|6 [[Foot|ft]]}}''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]]{{Film|II}} |skin=Blue |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Loyalist Committee]] *[[Galactic Empire]]''[[Lords of the Sith]]'' **[[Imperial Senate]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Need I remind you that it is I who leads our people in the Senate!|Orn Free Taa, to political rival Cham Syndulla|audio=NeedIRemindYou-LoR.flac|{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}}} '''Orn Free Taa''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Rutian]] [[Twi'lek]] [[Politics|politician]] who represented his [[homeworld]] of [[Ryloth]] in both the Senates of the [[Galactic Republic]] and of its [[Proclamation of the New Order|successor]] state, the [[Galactic Empire]]. Taa was unpopular on Ryloth, as he was content with amassing wealth for himself on [[Coruscant]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis]], Taa joined the [[Loyalist Committee]], which supported the Republic's leader, [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], against the growing threat of [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After the war, he retained his position in the [[Imperial Senate]]; while he kept his treasured wealth, he was little more than a puppet for the [[Galactic Empire]]. He conspired with Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart|Rampart]] to discredit Twi'lek freedom fighter [[Cham Syndulla]], though he was [[Crosshair|almost]] [[Death|killed]] in the process. He worked with [[Moff]] [[Delian Mors]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in trying to [[Mission to Ryloth|suppress]] Syndulla's [[Free Ryloth Movement]], though these efforts were unsuccessful. ==Biography== ===Naboo Crisis=== A [[Gender|male]] [[Rutian]] of the [[Twi'lek]] [[species]],{{TCW|Supply Lines}} Orn Free Taa [[Homeworld|hailed]] from [[Ryloth]] and joined the [[Galactic Senate]] to represent the planet. However, he made himself content with gaining wealth on the [[Galactic Republic]] [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]]{{Film|I}} and became entangled in [[politics]], making him a very unpopular figure on Ryloth itself. He was joined by his [[Orn Free Taa's partner|partner]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Chancellors, Senators and States Persons of the Republic}} in the Senate. Taa was among the [[senator]]s who supported [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s [[Vote of No Confidence]] to replace [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] with a stronger chancellor during [[Naboo]] [[Invasion of Naboo|occupation]] by the [[Trade Federation]]. ===The Separatist Crisis=== [[File:Bail.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Taa alongside Bail Organa in the Senate]] Ten [[Standard year|years]] later, Taa was present in Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Emperor's office|office]] suite when Amidala arrived to the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] following the assassination [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempt]] on her. He was later present in the Senate when Representative [[Jar Jar Binks]] pushed for Palpatine to have full emergency powers to handle the growing crisis. Taa represented Ryloth in the Galactic Senate; he was a trusted advisor to Palpatine, but a perfect symbol of corruption in government, extravagant with his spending and living in utter luxury. ===Clone Wars=== ====Concerning Ryloth==== {{Quote|What can the Separatists hope to gain from burning our homes?|Orn Free Taa, to Mace Windu and Cham Syndulla|}} [[File:Triumphant_fighters_on_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|250px|Taa and Syndulla set aside their differences to free their homeworld]] When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] [[Battle of Ryloth|invaded]] Ryloth, Taa contacted [[King]] [[Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria]] in efforts to receive aid to help the people on his [[planet]]. When the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Republic Navy|fleet]] broke through the Separatist [[blockade]], Taa arrived on Ryloth, where he came into conflict with his rival [[Cham Syndulla]] over what to do with the occupation. However, [[Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu]] convinced the two that they both wanted to see a free Ryloth and had to cooperate to help their people. When the [[Confederacy military|Separatist troops]] were defeated and [[Wat Tambor]] was arrested at [[Lessu City|Lessu]], Taa waved to the crowds at the Republic's victory parade and made peace with Syndulla. ====Other endeavors==== {{Quote|Watch it.''"
"''Excuse me.|Orn Free Taa and Jar Jar Binks|{{Film|III}}}} [[File:ObiWanAndSatineDebate.png|thumb|right|250px|Taa on the ''Coronet'']] Even though Taa was a loyalist, Taa made sure to keep his political options open, which led to him joining the neutral [[Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore]] on a journey{{SW|url=orn-free-taa-biography-gallery|text=Orn Free Taa Biography Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}} from [[Sundari]] to [[Coruscant]]. Other senators present included [[Kin Robb]] and [[Tal Merrik]]. Taa was present in the luxury suite where Duchess Satine rejected any statements made by Taa as he tried to persuade her towards joining the Republic. Taa then calmed [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Satine while they argued over the [[Clone Wars|war]] and reasons to fight. He dined alongside the other members of the party, where he urged that they not talk about [[politics]] and simply enjoy their meal of [[nuna]] legs. During the [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet|attack]] from [[SD-K4 assassin droid]]s, Taa was very frightened and cowered away from the table with his [[aide]]s. The senator then calmed down and sat back down at the table where he happily ate his favorite meal, however he was horrified when Kenobi rendered with the final metallic probe. When more Separatists forces attacked, he ran from the dining suite and ended up surviving the events.{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}} [[File:3D_herds_Orn_Free_Taa.png|thumb|left|300px|Taa during the hostage crisis]] When [[Cad Bane]] and several other [[bounty hunter]]s [[Senate hostage crisis|took over]] the Republic Senate building, Taa rushed into Palpatine's office to inform him of the situation. When Bane contacted Palpatine and told him of his deal, the bargain being that the Republic release [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]] and in return the trapped Senators would be released as well. Palpatine decided to comply with Bane and sent Taa down to the [[prison]] with the [[pardon disc]], he was not happy with the thought of being at the prison which Ziro even commented upon. Taa was, however, very happy when the Chancellor was freed and Bane's cohorts were surrounded by Commander [[Fox]]'s [[Coruscant Guard]].{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}} During the [[Republic military enhancement bill|bill]] that promoted further funding for the war speaker for the opposing campaign Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] was injured, meaning he was unable to attend and speak and causing a large delay for the speech. During the delay Senator [[Mee Deechi]] pushed for the voting to start without Organa's words. Taa agreed with this notion and vocally expressed his opinion, when [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] stepped forward to the speech, Taa looked very surprised at a partisan volunteering to make the speech. However, when Amidala gave her moving speech, Taa was visibly impressed and applauded her loudly.{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}} When Palpatine was rescued from [[General]] [[Grievous]] at the [[Battle of Coruscant]], Taa was among the Senators who greeted him on the landing platform. Pleased that Palpatine had been rescued, he stood in the second row. Representative Jar Jar Binks stepped on Taa's foot when they walked back inside. ===Age of the Empire=== ====Troubles with the New Order==== {{Quote|Despite your warnings, Cham Syndulla's proven to be more cooperative than anticipated.''"
"''Did you see how the crowd reacted to him? His influence over them is a problem. ''[…]'' Syndulla's fighters will always be loyal to him. They all must be dealt with.|Admiral Rampart and Senator Taa|{{TBB|Devil's Deal}}}} When Palpatine [[Proclamation of the New Order|declared]] the first ever [[Galactic Empire]], Taa was present in the [[Imperial Senate|Senate]]. Taa continued to serve loyally under the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor's]] dictatorship, thus keeping his wealth and heavy self-indulgence. Taa was however little more than a puppet delegate, serving under [[Moff]] [[Delian Mors]] and willingly taking part in the exploitation of his homeworld. However Taa was still happy as he retained his wealth and luxurious habits due to being a supporter of the Empire. Early in the [[Imperial Era]], in Ryloth's capital city of Lessu, a mass gathering was held by Senator Taa, Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart|Rampart]], Cham Syndulla, his wife [[Eleni Syndulla]], and [[Captain]] [[Howzer]], who looked upon the gathered crowd from the balcony. At the gathering, the Twi'lek senator delivered a speech to his fellow citizens, speaking about peace and prosperity the Empire would bring to the planet, and mentioned a new refinery being built. Orn Free Taa was nonetheless ridiculed and insulted by the Twi'lek crowd, and Cham Syndulla spoke up; the freedom fighter was cheered by the crowd. Subsequently, Orn Free Taa had a meeting with Admiral Rampart, during which he confessed his worries about the freedom movement led by the Syndullas. He came to the conclusion that the best option would be to get rid of Cham as quickly as it was possible. [[File:ChamThreatensTaa-DD.png|thumb|right|300px|Cham Syndulla holding Taa hostage.]] Later that day, in the evening, Taa, together with Rampart and Howzer, traveled on a [[Tank|Juggernaut tank]] to witness the arrest of [[Gobi Glie]] and [[Hera Syndulla]], the daughter of Cham, for alleged treason against the Empire and the people of Ryloth, and for smuggling weapons. However, the Juggernaut was attacked by insurgents who were trying to rescue the prisoners. While Rampart called for the tank to stop, Taa insisted on getting rid of the attackers. Cham and his wife Eleni then retreived their child, and while passengers left the tank, a quarrel arose between Taa and Syndulla. The latter threatned to kill the senator, holding a blaster against the former's torso. Captain Howzer and Admiral Rampart appealed to Syndulla's reason, and Eleni persuaded him to set Taa free. However, Rampart then ordered the clone [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair" to shoot Taa in the head, so that the senator was incapacitated. Two clone troopers quickly ferried Taa away from the spot, and Cham was accused of attempting to take Taa's life. Despite the shot, Taa survived.{{TBB|Rescue on Ryloth (episode)}} Later, Rampart addressed the citizens of Lessu at another public gathering and promoted opposition against the Free Ryloth Movement on account of this purported assassination attempt; he also stated that the senator would make a full recovery. After previously allying himself with his rival Cham Syndulla during the Clone Wars, he found himself at war with him. As head of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]], Syndulla carried out a [[Ryloth Insurgency|series of attacks]] against the [[Imperial Military|Imperial occupation forces]] on Ryloth, which gained the attention of the Emperor and his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]], [[Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Vader]]. ====Battles against the Ryloth resistance==== {{Quote|How do you fare, my friend?''"
"''Very well. Very well. But not ''so'' well, my Emperor. Because I know the spice production on Ryloth has slowed considerably due to…some unfortunate events, but—''"
"''By 'unfortunate events,' do you mean the terrorist attacks of the Free Ryloth movement?''"
"''Yes, my Emperor. They are mislead zealots and put all of my people at risk with their recklessness. But—between the Twi'lek security forces and the Imperial troops answering to Moff Mors, I believe matters are well in hand and that production will soon be back to full capacity.''"
"''Alas, I do not share your optimism, Senator. Nor your high opinion of Moff Mors.''"
"''But surely—''"
"''Because I do not think matters are 'well in hand,' I have made a decision.''"
"''My lord…''"
"''And it is this: Lord Vader and I will accompany you on an official visit to Ryloth. There we'll investigate matters for ourselves. I will notify Moff Mors that we are coming.''"
"''I…don't know what to say.''"
"''You need say nothing. The decision is made. The planning for the journey is already 'well in hand.'|Emperor Palpatine and Orn Free Taa|}} [[File:Star_Wars_Vader_Down_1_Final_Textless_Cover.jpg|left|thumb|300x330px|Taa was openly scared of Darth Vader, while the Sith Lord understood that Taa valued the Empire's interests last.]] After the attacks by the Free Ryloth movement began to slow the [[spice]] production on Ryloth, Taa was summoned for an audience with the Emperor. Now openly afraid of Palpatine and his apprentice, Taa feared the worst as he optimistically tried to reassure the Emperor that the [[Twi'lek security force]]s and Moff Mors would have the situation under control. Palpatine dismissed Taa's assertion and informed him that he had come to a decision. Taa was relieved to hear that the Emperor's decision was to accompany him and Vader on an [[Mission to Ryloth|official visit]] to Ryloth to investigate the matter personally. The senator expressed his reluctance to return to Ryloth, but Palpatine assured him his presence would reassure the people they were truly part of the Empire. Vader surmised that Taa was loyal to the Empire, though he would put his own interests first, Ryloth's interests second, and the Empire's third. Taa, his senatorial staff, and the two [[Sith Lord]]s traveled on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Perilous]]'' to Ryloth. However, one of Taa's senatorial staff leaked information about the trip to the Free Ryloth movement. Upon entering the [[Ryloth system]], the ''Perilous'' was attacked by [[Realspace|space]] [[mine]]s, [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]], and Free Ryloth rebels disguised as maintenance crew. During the attack, Taa was [[Force choke]]d by an enraged Vader, who released him at the Emperor's urging. Vader informed Taa that there was a [[spy]] among his staff. Taa apologized to Vader and the Emperor and vowed to find the [[Treason|traitor]]. The Emperor was convinced of Taa's loyalty but warned the Senator that it did not mitigate his fault; emphasizing that Taa was ignorant that he had a traitor among his staff. The Emperor then ordered his [[Emperor's Royal Guard|royal guards]] to restrict the senatorial staff to their quarters and to deny them access to communications equipment and computer terminals. The Emperor then warned Taa that harsher measures would be required in the future to quell unrest on Ryloth. Taa acceded to the Emperor's demands. When the ''Perilous'' fell apart, Taa and his staff escaped the [[Star Destroyer]] with Vader likening him to a "[[rat]] finding his way off a sinking ship." ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|How dare you attack our convoy! You are all traitors.''"
"''You threaten my daughter and accuse her of treason? For years, I've watched you put your greed and self-interests above Ryloth. You are the one guilty of treason.|Orn Free Taa and Cham Syndulla|}} [[File:OrnFreeTaa-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|right|250px|Jovial, yet corrupt, Orn Free Taa represented the Twi'lek people in the Galactic Senate, but he really put his own interests first.]] With blue skin and yellow eyes, Orn Free Taa stood 1.84 [[meter]]s tall and had five chins and four lekku, as well as four fingers on each hand. He had a legendary appetite.{{SW|url=orn-free-taa-biography-gallery|text=Orn Free Taa Biography Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}} He was joined in the Senate by a red-skinned Twi'lek woman identified to be his partner, alongside his aides [[Pampy]] and [[Supi]].''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' Orn Free Taa was a Republic Senator and later an Imperial Senator who represented his [[homeworld]] of Ryloth. Outwardly jovial, if a bit bumbling, the large shadow Taa carried was nonetheless cast over nearly all aspects of Coruscanti politics. In spite of his gregarious nature, Taa was a staunch militarist and was ever alert for opportunities to put [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] in his pocket. Even though his corruption was obvious, no one was able to find enough evidence of criminal behavior to oust the Twi'lek Senator.{{ForceCollection|Orn Free Taa|star=4}} While he demonstrated genuine concern for the people of Ryloth, he was known for his greed, cowardice, and putting himself first, the people of Ryloth second, and the Empire third. During the Battle of Ryloth, Taa saw that his presence on Coruscant was more helpful to his people's cause than being on their homeworld. The indulgent Twi'lek was seen by reformers as a symptom of the Republic's corruption, while in the Separatists' eye, he was a symbol of all the Republic's rottenness. When the Galactic Empire was formed, Taa retained his position in the Senate and, more importantly to him, his wealth. After the formation of the Empire, Taa sought to continue leading the people of Ryloth and gain their favor, showing bitter jealousy towards his political rival, Cham Syndulla, for winning his people over. Taa was determined to upstage Syndulla in any way possible that he was willingly to threaten his rival's daughter, [[Hera Syndulla|Hera]] in order to do so. ==Equipment== During the Clone Wars, Taa wore [[Coruscanti]] [[Clothing|robes]]. ==Behind the scenes== Orn Free Taa first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], where he was portrayed by [[Jerome Blake]], and continued to appear in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], played by [[Matthew Rowan]]. There is disagreement over whether Orn Free Taa was named because the name rhymed with "Corn Fritter" or if the named by [[Nick Dudman]] in tribute to his mentor [[Stuart Freeborn]].{{InsiderCite|219|Day Wanna Wanga - The Tale of the Twi'leks}} Concept art of Taa and an aide for ''Attack of the Clones'' was done by [[Dermot Power]] with the production code "dp339"{{WebCite|url=https://dermotpower.com/star-wars-episode-2attack-of-the-clones|work=[[Dermot Power]]'s website|text=Star Wars Episode 2:Attack of the Clones|archivedate=20260211111619}} and another piece was done by [[Stian Dahlslett]] and finished on [[May 16]], [[2003]].{{Tumblr|subdomain=starwars|name=''Star Wars''|url=post/111676047499/artist-of-the-week-stian-dahlslett|text=Artist of the Week - Stian Dahlslett|archivedate=20181218174618}} Taa re-appeared in the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', where he is played by voice-actor [[Phil LaMarr]] using a [[Wikipedia:French|French]] accent which was requested by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]] ("[[Liberty on Ryloth]]" - Featurette) Originally Taa's role in the episode "[[Hostage Crisis]]" was to be filled with [[Chairman]] [[Mas Amedda]], but Taa was ultimately used to save work on character models.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/hostage-crisis-episode-guide|text="Hostage Crisis" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} While ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the novel ''[[Lords of the Sith]]'', including Taa's visit to Ryloth with Darth Vader and Emperor Palpatine, in [[14 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the Biography Gallery of Taa's own Databank entry places it eight years after the end of the Clone Wars,{{Databank|orn-free-taa|Orn Free Taa}} or [[11 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the end of the [[Clone Wars]] to [[19 BBY]], so eight years afterward would equate to [[11 BBY]]. [[2021]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' also uses the 14 BBY placement.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Lords of the Sith'' to [[14 BBY]]. ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox|
